text:
sophia: quick heads-up — tangelo-v0.1-compact (int8) onboarding smoke shows locale regressions for CJK + some RTL bracket flips. ran full eval on multilingual-eval-suite.

sophia: metrics: ja BLEU -2.9, zh BLEU -3.6, ar bracket-mirror +12% error rate. link: https://rwd.internal/evals/1741501234 :eyes:

raja: can you paste a minimal repro (source -> fp16 -> int8) and tokenizer outputs? suspect quant kernel path or embed pruning mapping shift.

sophia: repro snippets below (fp16 vs int8 outputs):
```
src: 我喜欢吃苹果。
fp16: I like eating apples.
int8: I like eating apples .
```
```
src: ありがとう。
fp16: Thank you.
int8: Thank you .
```

sophia: also saw Arabic: "(هذا) كتاب" -> fp16: "(this) book" ; int8: " ) this ) book" (brackets mirrored/attached wrong).

chi-yu: interesting — tokenization preview shows subtle id shift after quant + embed prune. tokenizer dump: `tokenize("我喜欢吃苹果。") -> ['我', '喜欢', '吃', '苹果', '。']` but embedding indices for '喜欢' moved by +1 in int8 run.

lucas: so two hypotheses: 1) quantized kernel picks a different embedding table offset (bad pointer/align), or 2) our post-quant embed-prune step mutated vocab ordering. try run without prune: `rwd evaluate --model tangelo-v0.1 --quant=int8 --no-embed-prune --dataset cjk-smoke`

sophia: ran that. partial improvement: zh BLEU drop reduced to -1.1, ja -0.8, ar bracket errors gone on 98% samples. output: `I like eating apples.` (no extra spaces).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: build tangelo-v0.1-int8 image completed (sha256:abcd1234...). :white_check_mark:

raja: thanks, looks like embed-prune is the smoking gun. can you dump the `vocab.json` before/after prune and grep for the tokens around '喜欢' and the Arabic bracket chars?

sophia: attaching small diffs inline: `vocab_before['喜欢'] = id_3421`, `vocab_after['喜欢'] = id_3420` (one-off). bracket '(' moved from id_940 -> id_941 after prune.

lucas: filing task to make embed-prune stable across quant paths. also add sanity check that vocab->id mapping is invariant post-prune.

raja: created ticket ML-2317: "tangelo embed-prune causes vocab id shifts on quant builds" and assigned to @chi-yu + @raja. link: https://rwd.internal/issue/ML-2317

sophia: added failing prompt set to the ticket and a tiny bisect script: `./scripts/bisect_vocab_shift.sh --model tangelo-v0.1 --steps 20`.

lucas: plan — backport a guard in the quant pipeline to verify mapping and run a small canary on dedicated pool before promoting. canary window next Tue.

chi-yu: I'll take ML-2317 and start with a unit test that loads vocab, runs prune, then re-maps tokens -> ids and asserts equality. quick patch incoming. :thumbsup:

sophia: great, thanks everyone. if anyone sees other locale oddities ping here.

lucas: FYI we should also add a token-level diff to SDK eval output (highlight one-off id moves) so ops can auto-fail builds with mapping drift.

sophia: noted — created follow-up ML-2318 for SDK diff output.
